evals.name: Simple feature brief
evals.prompt:
Break this feature brief into user stories:

We need a password reset flow for our web app. Users should be able to request a password reset via email, receive a secure link, and set a new password. The link should expire after 24 hours. We also need to handle cases where the email doesn't exist in our system.
expectations: Generates at least 3 distinct user stories
Each story follows As a / I want / So that format
Each story has at least 2 acceptance criteria in Given/When/Then format
Covers the happy path (successful reset)
Covers the error case (email not found)
Covers the edge case (expired link)
Includes a priority for each story
Includes a size estimate for each story
Stories are ordered by dependency

evals.name: Complex PRD with multiple personas
evals.prompt:
Create user stories from this PRD:

## Feature: Team Collaboration Dashboard

We're building a dashboard where team members can share updates, managers can track progress, and executives can see high-level metrics.

### Requirements:
- Team members post daily standups (text + optional attachment)
- Managers see their team's updates aggregated by day
- Executives see department-level summaries with key metrics (velocity, blockers count)
- All users can comment on updates
- Managers can flag updates as 'needs attention'
- Notifications when someone comments on your update or flags it
- Data exported to CSV for reporting

### Constraints:
- Must support teams up to 50 members
- Updates should load within 2 seconds
- Mobile-responsive design required
expectations: Identifies at least 3 distinct personas (team member, manager, executive)
Creates a personas table
Generates at least 8 user stories
Groups stories logically (by epic or theme)
Includes non-functional requirements as stories or notes
Provides a dependency map or implementation order
Lists assumptions and open questions
Stories pass INVEST criteria check
Acceptance criteria are specific and testable

evals.name: Vague one-liner requirement
evals.prompt: I need user stories for: 'Add search to our product catalog'
expectations: Asks clarifying questions OR flags assumptions clearly
Still generates useful stories despite vague input
Covers basic search (keyword), results display, and empty state
Considers filtering and sorting as potential stories
Flags scope questions (autocomplete? fuzzy match? filters?)
Doesn't over-engineer — keeps stories reasonable for the vague input
